# Arizmi Labs

> For founders and teams building beyond the obvious. Arizmi Labs shapes ideas, builds systems, and ships digital products that need more than a dev shop.

Arizmi Labs is a product and software studio helping founders, operators, and teams turn early ideas into working digital products, platforms, and AI-enabled systems.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.arizmilabs.com/): Studio overview, process, capabilities, and ways to start a build.
- [Builds](https://www.arizmilabs.com/builds): The public build archive, spanning websites, platforms, AI systems, internal tools, and product concepts.
- [BluePrint AI](https://www.arizmilabs.com/blueprint-ai): A guided tool that turns a rough idea, workflow, or product opportunity into a PRD-style plan before development begins.
- [Services](https://www.arizmilabs.com/services): Product and software development services for digital products, platforms, AI systems, and operational tools.
- [About](https://www.arizmilabs.com/about): Arizmi Labs’ approach, principles, and team.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://www.arizmilabs.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of public pages.
- [Robots](https://www.arizmilabs.com/robots.txt): Crawler directives.
